passive.name: Call of the Freljord
passive.text: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

spells.name: Consume
spells.text: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

spells.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
spells.text: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it. The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

spells.name: Snowball Barrage
spells.text: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies. When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.text: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

damage.value: Nunu & Willump deal burst area damage when R's blizzard ends.

spikes.at: Q's cooldown falls to 9 seconds at its highest rank
spikes.why: Nunu & Willump can bite and heal more often.

bait.why: After Nunu & Willump use Q, its cooldown leaves them without its bite and heal.
After Nunu & Willump use W, its 14-second cooldown leaves them without its snowball knockup.
After Nunu & Willump use R, its long cooldown leaves them without the blizzard's slow and finishing damage.
